operations.name: describe
operations.purpose: Return protocol, adapter, schema, crypto, size, and operation capabilities
operations.controls: Public non-secret response with exact versions

operations.name: health
operations.purpose: Report bounded liveness/readiness and dependency state
operations.controls: No inventory, locator, credential, or key disclosure

operations.name: prepareProtectedBundle
operations.purpose: Validate the exact canonical unsigned domain payload and materialize an immutable short-lived protected-bundle staging object plus canonical descriptor/receipt
operations.controls: Controller authentication/scope, closed bundle type, cross-object reference equality, and active `AuthorBindingProfileV1` intended-author/role/capability/conditional-relationship checks precede a locked repository-private request fingerprint, `preparing` reservation, unique bundle/domain version and unpublished IDs. Extract the exact minimized relationship context and selected discriminator/capability into the immutable `AuthorBindingDecision`. Create fresh content/domain salts, DEK and nonce, salted commitments, exact `create-staging-controller-envelope` capability/envelope and lifecycle-managed encrypted staging object; verify both artifacts and their full unwrap/decrypt round trip, then commit `prepared` plus decision, descriptor, and challenge metadata before returning only the descriptor. No raw payload/salt/assembled challenge is separately retained and staging is not retrievable content. Exact retry begins at the committed `prepared` result; pre-commit crash recovery follows the frozen request-bearing/request-free rules

operations.name: recoverProtectedBundlePreparation
operations.purpose: Resume or clean an unpublished `preparing` materialization after process/key-agent/object failure
operations.controls: Internal request-free repository job only; acquire the same idempotency/staging row lock, accept no caller-supplied locator, and finish `prepared` only if the complete reserved object/envelope result verifies. A missing or invalid artifact is cleaned/retired and closed `rejected`, or `expired` at the materialization deadline; this job never rematerializes from a noninvertible fingerprint. Only an authenticated same-key/same-fingerprint `prepareProtectedBundle` retry carrying the complete request may start a new internal materialization revision before that deadline. Each recovery/cleanup attempt is bounded by `maxCleanupRecoverySeconds`; never return a descriptor or release a challenge before `prepared`; audit only safe IDs/state/digests

operations.name: consumeDomainAttestationChallenge
operations.purpose: Deliver the exact no-store signing challenge once to the intended domain author
operations.controls: Authenticate the exact active intended-author credential; require unexpired `prepared` delivery state and exact `unwrap-staging-for-challenge` key capability derived from that record/request. Inside the controller boundary recompute the controller-envelope commitment, unwrap the staged DEK, decrypt/verify the package, and combine only its payload/salt with the frozen non-payload fields. Recompute the challenge digest, atomically mark `delivered`, return no-store, zero transient plaintext, and emit minimized audit; wrong issuer/audience/author/capability/replay/expiry fails generically

operations.name: finalizeProtectedBundle
operations.purpose: Publish the byte-identical staged envelope under its reserved non-lifecycle final object ID, then atomically make the finalized bundle metadata visible and, only for an initially decision-critical bundle, authorize mandatory initial replication
operations.controls: Acquire the exact `ProtectedBundleStagingState` row with a bounded `FOR UPDATE` lock before authoritative validation and hold it through verification, publication, and commit. A committed `finalized` row returns the retained manifest/activation result without re-execution only when descriptor, finalization command, signatures and idempotency/result hashes match exactly; any mismatch conflicts. Otherwise require committed state `prepared`, unexpired staging and matching revision; cleanup uses this same lock. Require the challenge delivery record to be `delivered` and the domain author's exact `DomainManifestAttestation` author/address, bundle/type/domain/commitment, profile/domain, nonce, issued/expiry, fields and signature to match that record, its descriptor and recomputed `domainAttestationChallengeDigest`; reject `prepared`/`expired` delivery or a wrong-challenge signature. Verify the custody controller's separate exact `FinalizeProtectedBundle` command bound to its signed-domain-envelope digest, descriptor/receipt, author-binding-decision digest, commitments, both object IDs, stored-envelope digest/length, schema/context, immutable initial criticality class/profile, replica-policy digest, separately scoped nonce, issued-at, profile-bounded expiry and idempotency hash. Recompute the exact controller `recipientEnvelopeCommitment`; require its authorization/envelope/key/profile IDs and authenticated context to equal the descriptor; unwrap exactly one 32-byte DEK through the staged controller key; decrypt the staged content JWE; and verify its tag/AAD, exact self-contained package, both salted commitments, schema/context and exact stored-envelope digest/octet length. While the same transaction/row lock is held, stream the bytes through `get(stagingObjectId)` to `putIfAbsent(primaryObjectId)`, accepting recovery only when an existing final object has the exact digest/length; verify final `head/get`, activate the exact controller authorization/envelope, insert immutable manifest/finalization/attempt records, and commit state `finalized`. The bounded operation must commit or abort within `maxFinalizationSeconds` from lock acquisition. Only that commit makes the final object referenceable. Staging deletion follows idempotently and native lifecycle is a fallback; a timeout/failure rolls back the metadata transaction and deterministic recovery handles any unpublished final object. No content regeneration, plaintext persistence, or optimistic domain activation

operations.name: expireProtectedBundleStaging
operations.purpose: Remove unfinalized staging material without creating a domain or bundle version
operations.controls: Acquire the same staging-state row lock with bounded timeout. A matching retry against committed `expired` or `rejected` returns the retained close result without deletion; a conflicting reason/command fails. Otherwise proceed from `preparing` or `prepared` after expiry/rejection; a concurrent materializer/finalizer owns the lock, and `finalized` is never cleaned. Under that serialization, idempotently delete every unpublished staging object and any byte-identical but unpublished reserved-final object, retire unpublished/staged controller-custody authorizations/envelopes and destroy staging DEK material where possible, then commit `expired` or `rejected`. Each attempt is bounded by `maxCleanupRecoverySeconds`; an incomplete cleanup remains unavailable and retryable without extending any deadline. Native staging lifecycle is fallback only; no content release; audit every retry/outcome

operations.name: headProtectedBundle
operations.purpose: Resolve permitted metadata and availability without content release
operations.controls: Resource and purpose authorization plus minimization

operations.name: fetchCiphertext
operations.purpose: Stream the exact encrypted package from primary or replica
operations.controls: Current grant or replication authority, digest verification, bounded stream, audit event

operations.name: fetchPermittedContent
operations.purpose: Release minimum authorized full content or an excerpt
operations.controls: Authorization before access/decryption; exact recipient-repository-issued `unwrap-for-retrieval` capability derived from the current access decision, active grant and envelope; tag/AAD/package/commitment/signature checks; audit event

operations.name: searchProtected
operations.purpose: Search the custodian-local protected index and return minimum support objects
operations.controls: Authorization before search, source status propagation, no cross-custodian index, bounded results, audit event

operations.name: createDerivedArtifact
operations.purpose: Create a repository-local extracted representation or index for one confirmed source bundle/domain version
operations.controls: Exact off-chain signed command authorized by the bundle policy controller; source custody controller's repository process executes; bind source/type/domain, purpose, artifact type, method/model profile, retention profile, policy version, nonce, issued-at, profile-bounded expiry and idempotency hash; authorize before decrypting; conditional immutable descriptor creation; no central or replica index

operations.name: invalidateDerivedArtifact
operations.purpose: Make one repository-local derived artifact unavailable without changing its source bundle
operations.controls: Actor-requested invalidation uses an exact signed policy-controller command with actor/organization/credential, artifact/source/version, reason, policy, nonce, issued-at, profile-bounded expiry and idempotency hash. Canonical source-status or policy propagation is a distinct deterministic event-driven path requiring no fabricated actor signature. Both are idempotent terminal invalidations with audit; stale artifact cannot be searched or restored in place

operations.name: prepareAccessGrant
operations.purpose: Record a non-authorizing recipient/purpose/bundle grant proposal
operations.controls: Exact policy-controller-signed off-chain command, active policy/key, bundle/domain scope, operations, purpose, grant effective/expiry times, command nonce, issued-at, profile-bounded command expiry and idempotency hash; stored state `prepared`; no key release

operations.name: createGrantEnvelope
operations.purpose: Custody-controller key agent creates recipient-specific protected access to the existing DEK
operations.controls: Exact `create-grant-envelope` capability derived from the policy-controller-signed unexpired prepared grant; recipient public key, purpose/scope and controller path match; atomically persist verified envelope/commitment and activate grant; no separate recipient-envelope-creation signature and no plaintext-key persistence

operations.name: revokeGrant
operations.purpose: Block future mediated release
operations.controls: Exact policy-controller-signed off-chain command binding actor/organization/credential, grant and bundle/domain scope, purpose/policy/current state, reason, nonce, issued-at, profile-bounded expiry and idempotency hash; irreversible prepared-or-active grant transition, retained audit, explicit past-copy limitation

operations.name: rotateRecipientEnvelope
operations.purpose: Rewrap the unchanged DEK for a recipient organization's active successor encryption key
operations.controls: Exact signed `RecipientKeyRotationCampaign` item plus exact bundle-policy-controller-signed `RotateRecipientEnvelope`, unchanged active grant, and derived `rotate-recipient-envelope` capability. Verify campaign membership and both nonces/expiries/idempotency; create/verify and activate successor atomically. Failure keeps an uncompromised predecessor usable; normal predecessor-key retirement waits for complete required set; lost/compromised denies immediately and records unavailable items; package/replicas unchanged

operations.name: rotateControllerAuthorization
operations.purpose: Atomically move controller key administration to an active successor organization encryption key
operations.controls: Exact signed `RotateControllerAuthorization` plus derived `rotate-controller-envelope` capability, usable predecessor path, active successor key and exact policy/bundle/domain scope; create/verify and activate successor before retiring predecessor; failure retains predecessor and last-usable retirement is rejected; package/replicas unchanged

operations.name: recordEncryptionKeyState
operations.purpose: Record `pending/active/retired/revoked/lost/compromised` and enforce its online effect
operations.controls: Organization-key authority plus governance containment where applicable, reason/effective time, append-only predecessor/successor link; revoked/lost/compromised denies unwrap, no operator recovery bypass, explicit affected-bundle/request outcome

operations.name: replicateCiphertext
operations.purpose: Store the identical exact canonical content-JWE envelope at the approved neutral custodian for initial decision-critical activation or a pending promotion
operations.controls: Verify the complete canonical signature and controller scope of `FinalizeProtectedBundle` for initial replication or `ReplicateProtectedBundle` for promotion; exact staged/committed bundle/type/domain, digest/length, profile, committed replica-policy/destination, separately scoped nonce/issued-at/profile-bounded expiry/idempotency hash; no implicit key envelope; digest equality and auditable receipt

operations.name: verifyReplica
operations.purpose: Compare primary/replica bundle identity/version, exact stored-envelope octet length, and content-envelope digest and issue a typed receipt
operations.controls: No decryption needed; the active approved neutral-custodian EVM attestation key signs bundle/type/domain reference, digest, exact stored-envelope octet length, repository, criticality-profile ID/version, nonce, observation time, and profile-bounded expiry; auditable result

operations.name: inventory
operations.purpose: Produce a scoped conformance/recovery inventory
operations.controls: Operator/auditor purpose only; no content or key material
